## Behavior and scope

Macro controllers ctrl1..ctrl8: one mechanism, eight instances. Per-instance state is preserved even when arithmetic is shared (AGENTS.md).

Pinned source (read and cited, never copied): surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71; src/common/ModulationSource.h (modsources enum, pinned ids); src/common/ModulationSource.cpp; src/common/dsp/modulators/LFOModulationSource.cpp/.h; src/common/dsp/modulators/ADSRModulationSource.h; src/common/dsp/SurgeVoice.cpp (processControl mod routing application); fixtures/sequences/seq-macro-sweep-v1.json.

## Inputs / outputs / state

- Outputs: dry bus for this voice leaf unless the fixture is a wet-path case (AGENTS.md comparison rule); stereo scope as declared in the leaf's freeze doc.
- State: per-instance state is preserved even when arithmetic is shared (AGENTS.md); initialization, reset and event timing follow the SXT-021 control conventions.

## Fixtures and oracle
- Oracle: the pinned engine at surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71, 48 kHz (SXT-010 manifest); renders via `tools/render_fixture.py`, comparisons via `tools/compare_audio_reference.py` and `tools/compare_rtl_model.py`.
- Carrier presets (real normalized corpus entries): `resources/data/patches_3rdparty/Damon Armani/Pads/House Of Chords.fxp` (blob ceaa96a85b3fdd3d9f026087c70d6fb2a6e76057); `resources/data/patches_3rdparty/Damon Armani/Plucks/Main Brass.fxp` (blob 5377665368711db5785c98179ece7f9f3996392b); `resources/data/patches_3rdparty/Emu/Drums/Mort Snare.fxp` (blob 054b5228301468f6e867d77b4b89fe1a37a08867).
- Sequences: `fixtures/sequences/seq-macro-sweep-v1.json`.
- Parameter corners: the leaf freezes the observed normalized parameter ranges of its carriers plus the engine-declared ranges at the pin.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Frozen fixed-point model with word lengths + op order documented (`model/voice/` conventions).
- [ ] Model-vs-pinned-engine dry-render budgets reported on the carrier fixtures (PENDING-FREEZE; achieved numbers recorded, not tuned).
- [ ] RTL-vs-model exact at declared checkpoints (`tools/compare_rtl_model.py`, integer equality).
- [ ] Cycle/state costs recorded against SXT-016 probes and the SXT-015 accounting; divergences recorded, not reconciled away.
- [ ] **Negative control (must demonstrably fail):** routing-zeroed control (depth forced to 0, per destination class) and a source-swap control (landed modwheel in place of this source) - both must FAIL the reference-budget check. Committed control transcript required (pattern: reports/sxt-022/artifacts/negative-control.txt and tools/reverb_negative_controls.py).

filed_now.issue_body:
**Epic:** #2 · **Plan:** docs/surge-xt-chip-plan-v0.1-2026-09-20.md §6 · planning ID: SXT-033 · Generated by SXT-027 (#20), tool sxt-027-leaf-gen/1.0.0.

## Behavior and scope
Oscillator family 'Classic': full arithmetic at the pinned commit (all submodes of the family's submode selector, per-instance state, unison handling). The observed submode inventory comes from the committed normalized graphs; the engine-declared param set is read at the pin.

Partially landed: SXT-022 (#15) implements the exact Attacky configuration only (shape 0.0, sub mix 1.0, sync 0, unison 1). This leaf covers the remainder of the family (shape range, sub-oscillator mix, sync, unison stacking). Related: #15, #48.

Pinned source (read and cited, never copied): surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71; src/common/dsp/oscillators/ClassicOscillator.cpp/.h.

## Inputs / outputs / state
- Model domain: 48 kHz engine pin, float32-model placeholder word policy [PENDING-SXT-016/023]; fixed-point model conventions follow `model/voice/README.md` (SXT-022).
- Inputs: normalized graph state (`corpus/normalized/graphs.jsonl`, sha256 `c90424d91f2dc9ec4222c0cd28e4d0dba470dd895419db33305c53df39204715`) for the fixture carriers; missing definition state (LFO grids, ADSR) is read from the pinned engine post-loadPatch by a fail-closed extractor (`model/voice/extract_inputs.py` pattern), never guessed.
- Outputs: dry bus for this voice leaf unless the fixture is a wet-path case (AGENTS.md comparison rule); stereo scope as declared in the leaf's freeze doc.
- State: per-instance state is preserved even when arithmetic is shared (AGENTS.md); initialization, reset and event timing follow the SXT-021 control conventions.

## Fixtures and oracle
- Oracle: the pinned engine at surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71, 48 kHz (SXT-010 manifest); renders via `tools/render_fixture.py`, comparisons via `tools/compare_audio_reference.py` and `tools/compare_rtl_model.py`.

- Parameter corners: the leaf freezes the observed normalized parameter ranges of its carriers plus the engine-declared ranges at the pin.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Frozen fixed-point model with word lengths + op order documented (`model/voice/` conventions).
- [ ] Model-vs-pinned-engine dry-render budgets reported on the carrier fixtures (PENDING-FREEZE; achieved numbers recorded, not tuned).

**Epic:** #2 · **Plan:** docs/surge-xt-chip-plan-v0.1-2026-09-20.md §6 · planning ID: SXT-035 · Generated by SXT-027 (#20), tool sxt-027-leaf-gen/1.0.0.

## Behavior and scope
Modulation behavior 'modwheel' - pinned modsource ids 6 (ms_modwheel). Partially landed: the Attacky slice (SXT-022, #15) implements modwheel -> Filter 1 Cutoff/Resonance only. This leaf covers modwheel routes to arbitrary destinations (per the landed smoothing semantics). Related: #15.

Pinned source (read and cited, never copied): surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71; src/common/ModulationSource.h (modsources enum, pinned ids); src/common/ModulationSource.cpp; src/common/dsp/modulators/LFOModulationSource.cpp/.h; src/common/dsp/modulators/ADSRModulationSource.h; src/common/dsp/SurgeVoice.cpp (processControl mod routing application); fixtures/sequences/seq-modwheel-v1.json.

## Inputs / outputs / state
- Model domain: 48 kHz engine pin, float32-model placeholder word policy [PENDING-SXT-016/023]; fixed-point model conventions follow `model/voice/README.md` (SXT-022).
- Inputs: normalized graph state (`corpus/normalized/graphs.jsonl`, sha256 `c90424d91f2dc9ec4222c0cd28e4d0dba470dd895419db33305c53df39204715`) for the fixture carriers; missing definition state (LFO grids, ADSR) is read from the pinned engine post-loadPatch by a fail-closed extractor (`model/voice/extract_inputs.py` pattern), never guessed.
- Outputs: dry bus for this voice leaf unless the fixture is a wet-path case (AGENTS.md comparison rule); stereo scope as declared in the leaf's freeze doc.
- State: per-instance state is preserved even when arithmetic is shared (AGENTS.md); initialization, reset and event timing follow the SXT-021 control conventions.

## Fixtures and oracle
- Oracle: the pinned engine at surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71, 48 kHz (SXT-010 manifest); renders via `tools/render_fixture.py`, comparisons via `tools/compare_audio_reference.py` and `tools/compare_rtl_model.py`.
- Carrier presets (real normalized corpus entries): `resources/data/patches_3rdparty/Bluelight/Pads/Rainy Day Dreamaway.fxp` (blob 13979de9231f1b5d2b83e4370948cc33b5b52dfc); `resources/data/patches_3rdparty/Emu/Plucks/Pluck 2 Pad Demon Sad.fxp` (blob 428ead7abd1c00c8ee7bf55dc53345858bee7bce); `resources/data/patches_3rdparty/Inigo Kennedy/Atmospheres/Alone.fxp` (blob 9b8b3d8d31426ea9c7d35ca1991e48378d9d5489).
- Sequences: `fixtures/sequences/seq-modwheel-v1.json`.
- Parameter corners: the leaf freezes the observed normalized parameter ranges of its carriers plus the engine-declared ranges at the pin.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Frozen fixed-point model with word lengths + op order documented (`model/voice/` conventions).
- [ ] Model-vs-pinned-engine dry-render budgets reported on the carrier fixtures (PENDING-FREEZE; achieved numbers recorded, not tuned).
- [ ] RTL-vs-model exact at declared checkpoints (`tools/compare_rtl_model.py`, integer equality).
- [ ] Cycle/state costs recorded against SXT-016 probes and the SXT-015 accounting; divergences recorded, not reconciled away.
- [ ] **Negative control (must demonstrably fail):** routing-zeroed control (depth forced to 0, per destination class) and a source-swap control (landed modwheel in place of this source) - both must FAIL the reference-budget check. Committed control transcript required (pattern: reports/sxt-022/artifacts/negative-control.txt and tools/reverb_negative_controls.py).

## Deliverables
- `model/voice/` (model + freeze doc), `rtl/voice/` (schedule + harness), comparison runs under `reports/SXT-035/artifacts/`, evidence record `reports/SXT-035/EVIDENCE.md`.

filed_now.issue_body:
**Epic:** #2 · **Plan:** docs/surge-xt-chip-plan-v0.1-2026-09-20.md §6 · planning ID: SXT-036 · Generated by SXT-027 (#20), tool sxt-027-leaf-gen/1.0.0.

## Behavior and scope
Modulation behavior 'velocity' - pinned modsource ids 1 (ms_velocity), 30 (ms_releasevelocity). Velocity (and release velocity) modulation routes. Per-instance state rule: routes are per-scene and per-destination; state is never shared across scenes.

Pinned source (read and cited, never copied): surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71; src/common/ModulationSource.h (modsources enum, pinned ids); src/common/ModulationSource.cpp; src/common/dsp/modulators/LFOModulationSource.cpp/.h; src/common/dsp/modulators/ADSRModulationSource.h; src/common/dsp/SurgeVoice.cpp (processControl mod routing application).

## Inputs / outputs / state
- Model domain: 48 kHz engine pin, float32-model placeholder word policy [PENDING-SXT-016/023]; fixed-point model conventions follow `model/voice/README.md` (SXT-022).
- Inputs: normalized graph state (`corpus/normalized/graphs.jsonl`, sha256 `c90424d91f2dc9ec4222c0cd28e4d0dba470dd895419db33305c53df39204715`) for the fixture carriers; missing definition state (LFO grids, ADSR) is read from the pinned engine post-loadPatch by a fail-closed extractor (`model/voice/extract_inputs.py` pattern), never guessed.
- Outputs: dry bus for this voice leaf unless the fixture is a wet-path case (AGENTS.md comparison rule); stereo scope as declared in the leaf's freeze doc.
- State: per-instance state is preserved even when arithmetic is shared (AGENTS.md); initialization, reset and event timing follow the SXT-021 control conventions.

## Fixtures and oracle
- Oracle: the pinned engine at surge-synthesizer/surge@58914e59c608ed4384ba6002e44c3465c58b2e71, 48 kHz (SXT-010 manifest); renders via `tools/render_fixture.py`, comparisons via `tools/compare_audio_reference.py` and `tools/compare_rtl_model.py`.

- Sequences: `fixtures/sequences/seq-notes-coverage-v1.json`, `fixtures/sequences/seq-notes-repeated-v1.json`, `fixtures/sequences/seq-notes-holds-v1.json`.
- Parameter corners: the leaf freezes the observed normalized parameter ranges of its carriers plus the engine-declared ranges at the pin.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Frozen fixed-point model with word lengths + op order documented (`model/voice/` conventions).
- [ ] Model-vs-pinned-engine dry-render budgets reported on the carrier fixtures (PENDING-FREEZE; achieved numbers recorded, not tuned).
- [ ] RTL-vs-model exact at declared checkpoints (`tools/compare_rtl_model.py`, integer equality).
- [ ] Cycle/state costs recorded against SXT-016 probes and the SXT-015 accounting; divergences recorded, not reconciled away.
- [ ] **Negative control (must demonstrably fail):** routing-zeroed control (depth forced to 0, per destination class) and a source-swap control (landed modwheel in place of this source) - both must FAIL the reference-budget check. Committed control transcript required (pattern: reports/sxt-022/artifacts/negative-control.txt and tools/reverb_negative_controls.py).

- `model/voice/` (model + freeze doc), `rtl/voice/` (schedule + harness), comparison runs under `reports/SXT-036/artifacts/`, evidence record `reports/SXT-036/EVIDENCE.md`.
